title: Jumtukaay bu génn ci muy tekki
description: Waxtaan bii mingi dem ba ci àppu memory AI, melni tablo bu weex buy fees. We can expand the memory window (called context size) so it remembers more, but it may use more of your computer’s memory. Mën nanu itam dagg li nga dugal, loolu dafay tekki ni dina fàtte yenn ci jaar-jaaru waxtaan yi ngir mëna joxe palaas ngir mesaas yu bees.
increaseContextSizeDescription: Bëgg nga yokk dayo contexte bi?
lastRequestOverflowed: Laaj bi mujj dafa fees ci palanteer bi.
contextOverflowDetail: Laaj bii soxla na jeton {{request}}, waaye palanteer bi ci model bi dafay tëye {{context}} kese.
contextOverflowGeneric: Laaj bi dafa weesu dayo contexte bi jàppandi.
emptyReply: Model bi jeexal na te tontuwul. Jéemal defaraat, wala nga xool jekkal fournisseur bi.

engine.unknown: Model motër bi dafa am njuumte buñu xamul woon.
engine.MODEL_ARCH_NOT_SUPPORTED: Architecture model bii mënul ànd ak motër bi fi nekk. Yeesal motër bi ci Jekkal yi mën na yokk ndimbal.
engine.MODEL_LOAD_TIMED_OUT: Modèle bi yàgg naa yab, ñu taxawal ko. Modèle bu gëna ndaw wala dayo contexte bu gëna ndaw dafay faral di jàppale.
engine.MISSING_SHARED_LIBRARY: Bibliothèque bi motër bi soxla amul, moo tax mënul tàmbali.
engine.GPU_DRIVER_TOO_OLD: Sa dawalkat GPU daa màgget lool ci motër bii. Yeesal dawalkat bi, wala nga soppi ci motër CPU ci Jekkal yi, mooy saafara lii.
engine.OUT_OF_MEMORY: There is not enough memory to run this model. Modèle bu gëna ndaw wala dayo contexte bu gëna ndaw dafay faral di jàppale.
engine.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Benn ci jekkal model bi baaxul.
engine.IO_ERROR: Mënu ñu lire wala bind benn fichier bi ñuy tàmbali model bi.
engine.INTERNAL_ERROR: Amna lu jaarul yoon ci biir Novera bi ñuy tàmbali model bi.
engine.ENGINE_UNREACHABLE: Motëru llama.cpp mingi dox, waaye Novera mënul ko boole ci ordinatër bii (127.0.0.1). A VPN, proxy or security software may be blocking local connections.
engine.ENGINE_STOPPED: Motëru llama.cpp dafa taxaw ci luñu ko xaarul woon. Yonnee mesaas bi dafay tàmbaliwaat; if it keeps stopping, security software or the GPU driver may be the cause.
engine.UNSUPPORTED_CPU: Local models are not supported on this computer's processor. Novera's local engine is built for Apple Silicon Macs (M1 or newer), so it cannot start on an Intel Mac. Cloud ak fournisër yuñ personaaliseer ñu ngi wéy di dox.
